other_failure_modes.name: Feature engineering leakage before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates statistics based on the entire dataset (train + test) for feature engineering, such as frequency encoding. This leaks information about the distribution of the test set into the training features.

summary: The agent implements a generally solid and robust baseline using a 5-fold CV ensemble of LightGBM, CatBoost, and XGBoost. However, it introduces data leakage by computing frequency encoding on the combined train and test datasets prior to splitting. Additionally, the final ensemble relies on a naive unweighted average rather than optimizing the combination weights.
